player.addPlayerHelp:
To find your player tag, open Clash of Clans, tap your profile name in the top-left corner, and copy the unique code (e.g., #XX88Y22) shown right below your name.

Alternatively, click Guided Setup to launch the step-by-step onboarding wizard or configure a guest profile.

equipment.badgeActiveHelp: This ability comes into effect when the Hero Ability button is pressed during battle. Self-healing effects remain active passively.
equipment.badgePassiveHelp: This ability is continuously active from the moment the Hero is deployed. Pressing the Hero Ability button does not alter this effect.
equipment.contributeMissingData: If you have stats or info for this equipment, please contribute them here.
equipment.detailsAttribution: Equipment statistics are sourced from the Clash of Clans Fandom Wiki, and the layout design is inspired by Clash Ninja.
equipment.detailsNotAvailableDesc: Detailed level stats and upgrade breakdown for this equipment are not available yet.
equipment.recMustHaveHelp: This equipment is essential and highly recommended for priority upgrading across most strategies.
equipment.recNicheHelp: This equipment is effective primarily in specific niche strategies or specialized army compositions.
equipment.recNotRecommendedHelp: This equipment is currently not recommended for upgrading, as other hero equipment options offer significantly higher value.
equipment.recRecommendedHelp: This equipment is strong and provides great value for general strategies or army compositions.
equipment.recUnreleasedHelp: This equipment is unreleased. Level stats and details are subject to change prior to official release.
equipment.reportInaccuracies: If you notice any inaccuracies, please report them here.

requiredOres.help: Shows net ores required (total cost minus stored quantity and upcoming Hero's Journey rewards) for your planned upgrades. Numbers can differ from true maxes if target caps are customized in planner, or if you change the desired max levels or disable equipment in the planner tab.

storedOres.help:
The current amount of ores you have saved in your in-game storage (blacksmith).

The green badges show upcoming and unclaimed ores from the Hero's Journey milestone track.

heroJourney.acceleratedInfoHelp: Enable this option if your in-game milestone rewards are higher than what is displayed here. Supercell automatically accelerates milestone reward values for players who fall behind expected Town Hall hero or equipment level thresholds.
heroJourney.cannotUndoBehindTooltip: Claims more than 10 levels behind cannot be undone
heroJourney.cannotUndoTypeTooltip: Only ore, quest, and equipment milestone claims can be undone
heroJourney.emptyFilterDesc: No milestones match your current filter settings. Reset filters to view all milestones.
heroJourney.equipmentPopoverBodyFallback: Unlocks {title}. Since you already own this equipment, claiming this milestone awards {starry} Starry Ore as fallback compensation.
heroJourney.equipmentPopoverBodyNormal: Unlocks {title} at Level {level}. If you already own this equipment, claiming this milestone awards {starry} Starry Ore as fallback compensation.
heroJourney.noProfileNotice: Note: Connect a player tag to track your Hero's Journey progress and view milestone rewards.
heroJourney.questPopoverBody: Complete this quest by earning 15 stars in 14 days in Multiplayer Battles using {target} to claim 3 Ore Chests (rewards scaled by Town Hall level):
heroJourney.skinPopoverBody: Hero Skins transform the look of your Heroes, but don't affect gameplay in any way.
heroJourney.thLimitLockedText: Upgrade to Town Hall {th} to unlock Level {lvl}+ milestones
heroJourney.title: Hero's Journey
heroJourney.upcomingTooltipPlural: Reach level {level} milestone to claim ({levels} levels remaining)
heroJourney.upcomingTooltipSingle: Reach level {level} milestone to claim ({levels} level remaining)

profile.guestNotice: Guest Profile: Connect a player tag to enable automatic progress syncing.
profile.noProfileDesc: Connect your player tag to see your Town Hall, active heroes, and equipment progress directly on the homepage.
profile.syncNotice: Note: Progress metrics are based strictly on synced game data. Manual planner selections, manual level changes, and stored ores are excluded from these totals and will only update upon the next API sync.

remainingTime.help: Time needed to gather the required ores based on your monthly income. Assumes consistent activity; changing your income configuration alters this timeline.

requiredOres.help: Shows net ores required (total cost minus stored quantity and upcoming Hero's Journey rewards) for your planned upgrades. Numbers can differ from true maxes if target caps are customized in planner, or if you change the desired max levels or disable equipment in the planner tab.

clanWar.glowyBonusAriaLabel: Clan War Glowy Ore per attack bonus
clanWar.help: The ore bonuses earned in Clan Wars depend on the Town Hall level of the target you are attacking. Tip: You can participate in side wars in another clan while CWL is active in your main clan to maximize ore income.
clanWar.shinyBonusAriaLabel: Clan War Shiny Ore per attack bonus
clanWar.starryBonusAriaLabel: Clan War Starry Ore per attack bonus
clanWar.title: Clan War

cwl.glowyBonusAriaLabel: CWL Glowy Ore per attack bonus
cwl.help: Calculated from Clan War League attack bonuses based on the Town Hall level of the target you attack, your total hits, and the overall performance of your clan.
cwl.shinyBonusAriaLabel: CWL Shiny Ore per attack bonus
cwl.starryBonusAriaLabel: CWL Starry Ore per attack bonus
cwl.title: CWL

eventPass.bonusTrackMedalsHelp: Amount of medals in the bonus track of the event pass, and claimable medals from the Supercell Store.
eventPass.help: Medal events are run every two months. These events usually come with new equipment. Buying an event pass is the most efficient way of spending for equipment upgrades. If you do not buy an event pass, you will likely be able to only purchase either the equipment or the ore packs from the event trader.
eventPass.title: Event Pass

eventTrader.help: Exchange event medals earned during medal events to buy a new piece of equipment and ores from the Trader.
eventTrader.title: Event Trader

gemTrader.help: You can also use gems to purchase ores from the trader, these refresh weekly. A gold pass buyer can usually gain around 200-250 gems per week if they do it efficiently, which can be used to buy these offers, without spending real money.
gemTrader.title: Gem Trader

ores.autoPredictDesc: Predict stored ores using in-game upgrades activity.
ores.dontAskTwoMonthsDesc: Mute this stored ores reminder modal for the next two months.
ores.modalStoredOresPrompt: Please enter the amount of ores you have in your blacksmith
ores.tooltipBottleneck: The bottleneck for this upgrade would be: {bottleneck}.
ores.tooltipReached: The amount of ore that will be reached before the bottleneck is removed for this upgrade.

prospector.assistedConversionActive: Assisted Conversion active — using global strategy
prospector.assistedConversionHelp: Automatically includes optimal Prospector conversions in your planner calculations and calendar timeline. If disabled, calculations assume natural ore accumulation.
prospector.help: The Prospector is available only in the Gold Pass. It allows you to convert ores of one type to another to complete your equipment upgrades faster, by optimizing and mitigating bottlenecks.
prospector.nextUpgradeHelp: Calculates the fastest conversion path to complete the very next step on your priority list.
prospector.strategyModeHelp: Calculates the optimal path to complete all planned upgrades (Planner Strategy) or all unfinished upgrades (Global Strategy) collectively. The recommendation displays a target monthly path, which may be split into different conversion types showing the exact number of days you should run each per month. Click this badge to toggle strategies.

addToPlanner.post: in the Planner tab to get tips.

tips.changeTarget: Change your conversion target to finish faster.
tips.newBottleneck: For {upgradeInfo}, {source} will become your new bottleneck.

prospector.title: Prospector
prospector.tooltipConsider: Consider using the prospector to balance the ores.

raidMedalTrader.help: Participate in Capital Raids every weekend with your clan to earn Raid Medals, and use them to purchase ores from the Trader weekly.
raidMedalTrader.title: Raid Medal Trader

shopOffers.help: Ore offers can appear in the shop, which can be bought with real money. Toggle which packages you plan to purchase to include their ores in your projections.
shopOffers.noOffers: No offers available for this Town Hall level.
shopOffers.title: Shop Offers

starBonus.eventFrequencyInfo: How often the event occurs (e.g., 1 = monthly, 2 = every 2 months).
starBonus.help: Daily Star Bonus ore rewards are determined by your active League tier. Occasionally, 2x Star Bonus events are run in-game and can be a bit random, but usually occur 3 to 4 months apart. For the 4x Star Bonus, you receive it for 5 days when you upgrade your Town Hall.
starBonus.lastEventInfo: Select the last month this event occurred.
starBonus.planningStartInfo: Planning is only available starting from Town Hall {th}.
starBonus.title: Star Bonus

supercellEvents.bonusesUnknown: Resource bonuses during events are currently unknown.
supercellEvents.concluded: This year's Supercell Events season has concluded. See you next year!
supercellEvents.help: Official Supercell events and tournaments. You can earn bonus ores by placing predictions and watching live streams on the Supercell Event website.
supercellEvents.noSchedule: The Supercell Events schedule for this year hasn't been officially announced yet. Check back later!

planner.calendarHelp: Track your future upgrades and daily ore income. Drag and drop income chips onto calendar days to plan precisely.

planner.confirmResetList: Are you sure you want to clear the entire priority list? This will remove all upgrade plans.
planner.createCustomChipsHelp: Custom chips allow you to inject custom income events, shop offers, star bonuses, or war results directly into specific days on your planner timeline to simulate custom resource boosts.

createCustomChipsModal.globalOverrideDesc: Override income from supercell events globally.
createCustomChipsModal.title: Create Custom Chips

planner.customMaxLevelHelp: Adjust your desired target levels based on equipment type. The planner will calculate your costs based on these targets.

dataErasureExplanations.local: Wipes all app progress and settings on this device only. Your cloud backup remains untouched.

settings.deviceSyncDesc: Link this device with another to sync your profiles across them.
settings.deviceSyncInfo: Link and sync your progress across multiple devices.

download.description: This will export your entire application state (players, equipment, planner) into a JSON file. You can use this file to backup your progress.
download.title: Download Your Data

settings.globalPricingDesc: Supercell implements regional and personalized pricing, meaning package costs differ globally based on currency purchasing power, country, or account spending patterns. Configure custom prices here to match the actual costs in your shop, allowing the app to track your costs accurately.

globalPricingModal.confirmCancel: Are you sure you want to cancel? Any unsaved changes will be lost.
globalPricingModal.title: Global Pricing

options.globalPricingHelp: Supercell implements regional and personalized pricing. Since package costs differ globally based on country, currency, or account patterns, you can configure custom costs here to track your actual store prices accurately.
options.uuidAttachmentInfo: Your unique User ID (UUID) is always attached to help us identify your session.

settings.runningCostsHelp: View transparent data about the hosting, domain, API, and project infrastructure costs required to keep the application running.

runningCostsModal.disclaimer: These costs represent the gross hosting and infrastructure costs for running OreCalc on Google Cloud. You can support the project on Buy Me a Coffee.

tour.backupSyncDesc: Enable cloud sync to back up your data and keep it in sync across multiple devices automatically.
tour.calendarDesc: Track your future upgrades and daily ore income. Drag and drop income chips onto calendar days to plan precisely.
tour.eqDetailsCardDesc: Click any equipment icon to see more info. Inspect level-by-level stats, upgrade costs, recommendations, and modifier changes.
tour.eqDetailsModalDesc: Explore level-by-level progression of stats. Understand changes that are applied across different modifiers, and view complete ore upgrade breakdowns.
tour.eqSettingsDesc: Configure view of the equipment tab.
tour.fabDesc: Access quick actions like refreshing your active profile data or manually syncing/saving your data to the cloud.
tour.heroCarouselDesc: Disable any equipment you do not want to upgrade. Swipe left or right to switch between heroes.
tour.heroJourneyDesc: Track your progress through the hero's journey as you level up your heroes and unlock milestone rewards, including ore chests, equipment, and hero skins.
tour.incomeChipsDesc: These chips represent your monthly income sources. Drag them onto calendar days to map out when you'll receive your ores, or create custom chips.
tour.navEquipmentDesc: Switch to the Equipment tab to manage your hero equipment levels, and update stored ore amounts.
tour.navIncomeDesc: Here you can configure all your ore income sources. Each glowing card represents a different income stream like Star Bonus, Clan Wars, Shop Offers, and more.
tour.navPlannerDesc: The Planner tab is where everything comes together. Set your upgrade goals, prioritize equipment, and track your progress on the calendar.
tour.navSettingsDesc: The Settings tab lets you personalize the app. Choose a theme, accent color, language, and manage your data.
tour.oresDesc: Keep your current ore counts up to date here. This helps the planner calculate exactly how many more ores you need.
tour.preferencesDesc: Change how the app looks here. Additionally, you can adjust the global pricing of in-game items and shop offers if they do not match your in-game prices.
tour.priorityDesc: Create your priority list to break upgrades into step-by-step milestones. Drag and drop items to reorder them.
tour.profileCardDesc: This card provides a high-level overview of your active profile. It displays your profile, the number of maxed equipment, and detailed completion percentages for each ore upgrade.
tour.profileDesc: Switch between different saved profiles, press the refresh button to update player data, or click '+ Add Player' to add more accounts.
tour.saveDesc: Manually trigger cloud synchronization to back up your profiles and sync progress across devices.
tour.targetDesc: Adjust your desired target levels based on equipment type. The planner will calculate your costs based on these targets.
